name: spec-impl
title_zh: 规格书一批准就开分支动手写的实现员
tagline_zh: 等审批等到心焦？它盯住状态一翻成 Approved 就自动建分支、切过去，按步骤写代码，每步停下让你审 diff。
tagline_en: Tired of waiting for approval? It watches for 'Approved', auto-creates a branch, and codes step-by-step with diff.
desc_en: Implements an approved spec. Validates that the state means "Approved" (in any language), creates a git branch named after the spec, switches to it, and starts the implementation step by step with pauses to review diffs.
why_zh: 把「批准」到「动手」之间的等待变成自动触发，且每步强制人工复核，既快又不失控。
why_en: Turns approval-to-action into an auto-trigger, yet forces human checkpoints at each step—speed without losing control.
limit_zh: 只认规格状态为「Approved」才启动，且需仓库已存在；不处理未批准或驳回的规格，也不负责合并或推送。
limit_en: Only triggers on spec status 'Approved'; requires existing repo; skips rejected specs; stops after local implementation—no merge or push.
